basic_info: 61-year-old male presenting with worsening back pain, hematuria, and dizziness on exertion.
present_illness: The patient reports worsening back pain over the last four days, initially on the right side but now more on the left. The pain is constant, severe (8-9/10), and exacerbated by exertion. He also reports hematuria, which is difficult to detect but notes a change in urine color (faint pinkish tint), and dizziness on exertion. Tylenol provides minimal relief. The patient does not report numbness or weakness, but he does feel some body aches because he is favoring his back when he walks. The pain sometimes feels like it's in his abdomen too, especially when he is exerting himself. He also notes decreased urinary frequency and a weaker urine stream. The stream seems weaker, and he has been urinating less frequently than usual. He also feels like he doesn't completely empty his bladder when he goes. The patient has not experienced any recent changes in bowel movements or swelling in the legs.
past_history: History of kidney stones two years ago. Current medications: Imitrex for migraines and Protonix 40 mg/day for reflux. Patient needs a refill on Protonix. No known allergies. No prior urological evaluations or imaging related to urinary symptoms. No urodynamic studies or cystoscopy performed in the past. No history of urinary retention or complete inability to urinate.
physical_exam: Vital signs: BP 130/85 mmHg, HR 78 bpm, RR 16, Temp 36.8°C. No acute distress. Back tenderness to palpation, more pronounced on the left side. No neurological deficits. Abdominal examination reveals mild tenderness without guarding or rebound. No edema in the lower extremities. Bowel sounds normal without tenderness.
aux_exam: Urinalysis: Hematuria present, no leukocytes or nitrites. Renal function tests: Serum creatinine 1.2 mg/dL, BUN 18 mg/dL. Imaging: Non-contrast CT of the abdomen and pelvis pending. Prior imaging: None reported. Urodynamic studies: Not performed. Cystoscopy: Not performed. No prior imaging studies for back pain or urinary symptoms reported.
